messages:
emily (support): FYI — Oliver from BrightBank reporting repeated 429s since ~08:30 PDT. They also see occasional upstream 520s from our gateway. Escalating to oncall.

oliver (acct): Yep, users see errors + retries. We didn't roll anything. Starts around 08:29. I'll attach a failed request id.

emily (support): thx. any client retry/backoff config? any cron or batch jobs running near that time?

oliver (acct): 5 workers, each ~10 req/s at peak, linear backoff, retry=3. rough peak ~50 req/s. no cron.

emily (support): sample from their logs (attached):
```
2026-03-16T15:31:02Z ERROR req_7f8a1c 429 rate_limited
2026-03-16T15:31:02Z WARN req_7f8a1c upstream=proxy-12 520
```

raj (eng-oncall): can you paste the x-request-id (or our request id) from a failed call and which route/model?

oliver (acct): request id: req_7f8a1c, model=redwood-embed-3, route=/v1/embeddings

emily (support): copying logs into thread so SRE/Oncall can triage.

maria (sre): pulling ratecap traces now. initial look: brightbank org shows sustained TPM ~3k and RPM ~180k in the 08:30 window. Our org-level embedding RPM default is 100k (per-region), looks like they hit combined/global thresholds. also seeing ~2k concurrent connections.

maria (sre): gateway returned 520s when backends were saturated. clients then retried immediately -> cascade -> more 429s. likely a retry storm + insufficient client backoff + no request folding on this route.

raj (eng-oncall): that matches my hypothesis. quick mitigations: 1) temporary rate bump for the org, 2) enable request folding/aggregation on embeddings route, 3) ask client to use exponential backoff with jitter.

emily (support): Oliver — want us to enable a short bump while we investigate? will need approval.

oliver (acct): Yes please. SLA impacted. We'll also update our client to exponential backoff immediately.

emily (support): applying temporary bump now (60s high bump then taper).

deploy-bot: toggle-ratecap applied: org=brightbank id=org_998 rate_bump=50% duration=120s by emily (support) :white_check_mark:

maria (sre): watching metrics — after the bump 429s dropped ~80% and upstream 520s stopped. 5xx->429 feedback loop cleared.

maria (sre): action items: 1) advise client to reduce concurrency/add jitter; 2) eng to investigate proxy retry handling and enable request folding; 3) update docs with embedding typical TPM/RPM guidance.

raj (eng-oncall): opened ENG-5423 to debug gateway retry behavior + folding. tagging platform. will follow up with timeline.

emily (support): sending recommended client snippet to Oliver (per-team guidance):
```
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 4
  backoff:
    type: exponential
    base_ms: 200
    max_ms: 5000
    jitter: true
concurrency: 5
```
Link: https://redwood.example/docs/rate-limits - suggests embedding workloads should cap sustained TPM to our published guidance and use request batching when possible.

oliver (acct): thanks — please share final notes for our SRE team and confirm when ENG ticket closed.

maria (sre): will follow up with a short postmortem and recommended limits. leaving open until we validate proxy fix.

raj (eng-oncall): TL;DR: client retry storm + gateway 520s triggered 429 cascade. Temporary rate bump applied, client to switch to exp backoff + jitter, ENG will fix folding/retry behavior.

emily (support): closing loop with customer now. 👍
